text:
elaine: Quick sync — audit coverage matrix attached below. We still have gaps across API gateway auth mapping, console admin events, billing usage/credit events, runtime model-load and fallback traces. Need triage + owners.

josh: can you paste the matrix? don't have the doc open.

elaine: pasted matrix snippet:
```
service,missing_events,severity,proposed_fix
api-gateway,route_auth_failed|token_mismatch,high,emit event + include principal_id|request_id
auth,role_change|password_reset,high,log role changes w/ before/after attrs
console,org_settings_change,medium,add admin_event type
billing,invoicing_webhook|invoice_view,high,emit billing.event with invoice_id
runtime,model_fallback|quantize_fail,medium,add runtime.trace events
```

maya: for runtime, we already have model_load and cache_hit -- what's missing for fallback?

samir: we don't forward fallback to central audit pipeline. it's only in local node logs. need to standardize event schema and ship to audit-kinesis.

olivia: also KMS operations: key rotation and key use are not being surfaced to customer-facing audit for private deployments (we redact key_id). customers want a tokenized key id. need policy.

josh: RBAC changes: when admin grants a role via console/API, we must emit both admin_action and target_principal_change with before/after role arrays. compliance asked for who and what.

elaine: agreed. proposed schema additions: event_type, principal.id, principal.type, resource.id, resource.type, props.before, props.after, request_id, service_origin, severity

samir: +1. for backfill: we should run a rolling backfill for last 180 days for billing and auth where gaps are high. that will need storage + compute estimate.

maya: estimate: billing backfill ~ 3TB logs, + Spark job to transform -> put into audit-s3, then into kinesis. I'll open an RFC.

olivia: customer-facing validation: we need a validator binary to run in Dedicated/Private that checks event conformance and redaction rules. it should be in /tools/audit-validator and mirror the cloud spec.

elaine: action list (short):
- josh: own API gateway instrumentation PR (due Tue)
- maya: RFC for runtime backfill + job estimate (due Fri)
- samir: pipeline change to accept fallback events + kinesis topic (start Mon)
- olivia: KMS redaction policy + sample tokenization schema (due Wed)
- elaine: update audit spec in GH and add schema migration notes

josh: i'll post PR link when ready. tagging @audit-bot to run schema lint.

audit-bot: schema-lint: queued. errors: none. warnings: resource.type not documented for billing. See https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw/audit-spec/pull/42

samir: can we add an integration test that simulates a role change and asserts event includes before/after? I'd like that before we flip on in prod.

olivia: yes — add test harness in private-deploy CI.

elaine: cool. anyone blocked on permissions or infra to start?

maya: need a temp IAM role to write to audit-s3 for backfill. CC infra.

infra-bot: created role audit-backfill-writer, expires in 7d. :white_check_mark:

samir: thanks infra. I'll schedule pipeline slot.

elaine: OK closing triage thread. I'll consolidate in GH issue and assign. :eyes:

josh: thanks all.
